turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! How are you feeling today? I know you were recovering from that nasty flu recently, hope you're starting to get your energy back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Yes, I'm feeling a lot better, thank you. I'm almost back to one hundred percent. To help ease back into things, I started my morning with some hot water steeped with fresh ginger root, which was really soothing.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a great way to start the day. Are you scheduled for a shift at the hospital tonight, or do you have the evening off?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I do have a shift tonight. I'm actually getting my things together right now because I'll be catching the late-night city transit bus to get to the ER in a bit.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Got it. Make sure you don't push yourself too hard on your first few shifts back. Do you have everything you need to get through the night?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I think so! I made sure to prepare ahead of time and packed up the remaining portion of yesterday's dinner to eat during my break, so I won't have to worry about finding food at 2 AM.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Smart move. Having a home-cooked meal ready to go makes those late shifts much more manageable. Have you and Tom been able to spend some time together since you started feeling better?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We actually did! We had a really nice, quiet dinner together yesterday evening, which is exactly where those great leftovers came from.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's wonderful to hear. I'm glad you two got to connect. How is the Phoenix heat holding up? I imagine it's still pretty intense this time of year.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, it's absolutely scorching during the day. That's another reason why taking the bus at night is so nice—the air conditioning is always blasting, and I don't have to deal with a burning hot steering wheel.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That is definitely a huge plus in July! Once your shift is over and you get some downtime, are you hoping to get back to any of your sourdough baking, or are you still taking a break from hobbies?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I might try to feed my starter tomorrow morning when I get home if I have the energy, but I'm taking it one step at a time. Anyway, my ride will be here soon, so I should head out!
